The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

To both parties: the deviation gate fails and the fare already charged stands. The governing distance is the GPS trace, EV-GPS-02819, which measures 3.96 km; the booked optimal route on EV-TRIP-02819 is 3.2 km. The excess is therefore 0.76 km, or 23.75% of the optimal route. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH limbs to pass: the excess must be greater than 20% of the optimal distance AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. The percentage limb passes (23.75% > 20%), but the absolute limb fails (0.76 km is not greater than 0.8 km). The trace figure governs and the trip record's rounded 4.0 km may not be used for the threshold test; even that figure gives exactly 0.80 km, which likewise is not greater than 0.80 km. No deviation is established, and POL-RD-01 directs the outcome NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. The SGD 9.64 charged on EV-FARE-02819 stands and the SGD 1.50 the rider contests is not returned. This is not a win for either side on the merits of the route; it is the threshold doing its job. No adjustment clause displaces the 3.2 km baseline. The trip record carries no amendment (pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null), so POL-RD-05 cannot run. The vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply. The chat log EV-CHAT-02819 carries zero messages, so POL-RD-04's rider-instruction route is unavailable and its 200 m test cannot be run. The driver's explanation 'One-way streets' is an external-traffic assertion with no traffic_advisory behind it. EV-ADVIS-02819-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 that assertion carries no weight and exonerates nothing. It does not need to: the excess never reaches the threshold, so nothing turns on it, and no escalation follows from the missing advisory because no party cited the absent identifier. Nothing else is refundable. EV-FARE-02819 shows ERP of 0.00 with no gantries, no airport surcharge, no waiting-time fee and no promo discount, so there is no billing-integrity defect and no POL-RD-09(4) referral. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes (45 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, max gap 0.0 s), so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged. All three deciding artifacts carry trip TRP-02819 with consistent timestamps, so POL-RD-10(2) and (4) are excluded. The driver profile, EV-DPROF-02819, shows 1 deviation flag in 90 days against 314 completed trips — far below the POL-RD-06 pattern test — so there is no conduct referral and no FULL_REFUND uplift. The rider's own POL-RD-02 arithmetic (recomputed fare 8.68 against a charged total of 9.64, a refund of 0.96 rounded up to SGD 1.00) is not reached, because that computation only runs once a deviation is established. Confidence is 0.90, capped by the weight-1.0 artifacts (EV-GPS-02819 and EV-TRIP-02819) that carry the deciding measurement. The monetary effect is nil, below the automatic execution threshold, so no amount moves. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

The driver advocate

kept The governing distance measurement is the trace, not the trip record, and on the trace no deviation is established. EV-GPS-02819 records trace_distance_km of 3.96 km; EV-TRIP-02819 stores the booked optimal_distance_km as 3.2 km. The excess is therefore 0.76 km, which the platform's own derived block states as excess_km 0.76 / excess_pct 23.75 and tags status 'no deviation'. POL-RD-01 is a two-limb gate: a deviation is ESTABLISHED only when the excess is greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, and both tests must pass. The percentage limb is cleared at 23.75%, but the absolute limb fails by 0.04 km. No deviation exists, and under POL-RD-01 the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip.

evidence EV-GPS-02819, EV-TRIP-02819 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept The threshold test fails even on the reading most favourable to the rider. POL-RD-01 fixes which field governs where the two distance fields disagree: gps_trace.trace_distance_km governs, and trip_record.actual_distance_km is a rounded convenience copy that may NOT be cited for the threshold test. EV-TRIP-02819 rounds the same measurement up to 4.0 km, and 4.0 km less the 3.2 km optimal is exactly 0.80 km — not greater than 0.80 km. The absolute limb therefore fails on the rounded figure as well, so the result is the same whichever field is read.

evidence EV-TRIP-02819, EV-GPS-02819 · clauses POL-RD-01

The booked optimal of 3.2 km is the correct baseline for POL-RD-01.

discarded The absent advisory does not turn this into an escalation. To both parties: the deviation gate fails and the fare already charged stands. The governing distance is the GPS trace, EV-GPS-02819, which measures 3.96 km; the booked optimal route on EV-TRIP-02819 is 3.2 km. The excess is therefore 0.76 km, or 23.75% of the optimal route. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH limbs to pass: the excess must be greater than 20% of the optimal distance AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. The percentage limb passes (23.75% > 20%), but the absolute limb fails (0.76 km is not greater than 0.8 km). The trace figure governs and the trip record's rounded 4.0 km may not be used for the threshold test; even that figure gives exactly 0.80 km, which likewise is not greater than 0.80 km. No deviation is established, and POL-RD-01 directs the outcome NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. The SGD 9.64 charged on EV-FARE-02819 stands and the SGD 1.50 the rider contests is not returned. This is not a win for either side on the merits of the route; it is the threshold doing its job. No adjustment clause displaces the 3.2 km baseline. The trip record carries no amendment (pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null), so POL-RD-05 cannot run. The vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply. Under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 that assertion carries no weight and exonerates nothing. It does not need to: the excess never reaches the threshold, so nothing turns on it, and no escalation follows from the missing advisory because no party cited the absent identifier. Nothing else is refundable. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes (45 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, max gap 0.0 s), so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged. The driver profile, EV-DPROF-02819, shows 1 deviation flag in 90 days against 314 completed trips — far below the POL-RD-06 pattern test — so there is no conduct referral and no FULL_REFUND uplift. To the rider and the driver. The whole case turns on 40 metres, and the policy resolves it. DISTANCE. The distance actually driven is the GPS trace on EV-GPS-02819: 3.96 km. The booked optimal route on EV-TRIP-02819 is 3.2 km. The excess is therefore 0.76 km, which is 23.75% of the optimal route. POL-RD-01 makes that a deviation only if BOTH limbs of its gate pass: the excess must be greater than 20% of the optimal route (it is, at 23.75%) AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms (it is not — 0.76 km falls 40 m short). One limb fails, so no deviation is established for this trip. The trip record's rounded 4.0 km would give exactly 0.80 km, which also does not exceed 0.80 km, and POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern the threshold test in any case, so the result is the same whichever field is read. The rider's advocate conceded this point, correctly. WHAT FOLLOWS. Because no deviation is established, POL-RD-01 sends the case to NO_ACTION however the trip is characterised, and the only route left open by that clause is a billing-integrity refund under POL-RD-09(4), which does not arise here. The rider's alternative arithmetic — charged_total 9.64 less a recomputed_fare of 8.68, a refund of 0.96 rounded up to 1.00 — is therefore moot: POL-RD-02 never runs. The SGD 1.50 the rider contested is not refunded, the metered fare of 9.64 stands, and refund_issued_sgd remains 0.00. THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. 'One-way streets' is an assertion of an external traffic cause citing no evidence. There is no traffic advisory for this corridor anywhere in the bundle: EV-ADVIS-02819-01 is MISSING, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and the issue code that fired is MISSING_ARTIFACT. POL-RD-03 cannot be run without an advisory that names a road or segment the optimal route traverses and carries a validity window, so the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13 and neither reduces nor replaces the measured excess. It does not escalate the case either: the driver named no advisory identifier, and POL-RD-13(1) provides that an assertion citing no artifact cannot invoke POL-RD-10(5) against one. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02819) holds zero messages, so POL-RD-04's rider-instruction route is unavailable and its 200 m test could not be run, and POL-RD-05's amendment route is closed (pickup, dropoff and amended optimal are all null). THE MONEY LINES. EV-FARE-02819 shows ERP and tolls of 0.00 with no gantry charged, an airport surcharge of 0.00 on a trip that does not originate at an airport, a zero waiting-time fee and a zero promo discount: no phantom line, and no billing-integrity referral under POL-RD-09(4). The fare model is METERED with no quoted fare, so POL-RD-11's upfront-quote bar is not in issue, and the surge multiplier read from EV-FARE-02819 is 1.0. Every charge line has a counterpart in the trip record's distance and duration, so POL-RD-10(8) is not engaged. REMAINING CLAIMS. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check shows no repeat deviation pattern (deviation_flags_90d 1 against completed_trips_90d 314, which is 0.32%, with 314 trips above the 40-trip minimum), so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral; the check was confined to the two 90-day fields POL-GEN-01 permits, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter was not used. The rider's 60-day profile does not trigger POL-RD-08's corroboration requirement (1 claim, 0 substantiated). The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (45 fixes, 10-second interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps, no jump over 500 m), so no gap-handling consequence and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises. Trip identifiers and timestamps match across EV-TRIP-02819, EV-GPS-02819 and EV-FARE-02819, so POL-RD-10(2) and (4) are excluded, and no other POL-RD-10 trigger fires. The vehicle is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12's pooled-itinerary baseline does not apply and the 3.2 km booked optimal stands; and there is no unbilled-distance shortfall, so no POL-RD-04 driver compensation is due. CONFIDENCE AND PROCESS. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor; the ruling rests on EV-GPS-02819 and EV-TRIP-02819, both at full weight 1.0, and on no impaired artifact. The monetary effect is nil, well below the automatic-execution threshold. One driver submission was discarded by the citation check for citing the impaired advisory without naming its issue code; the rider's submissions on the same advisory did disclose its weight of 0.0 and MISSING_ARTIFACT and were considered.
To both parties: this case turns on a single arithmetic gate in POL-RD-01, and it fails by 40 metres. MEASUREMENT. The governing distance is the GPS trace, EV-GPS-02819, at trace_distance_km 3.96 km — not the rounded 4.00 km convenience copy on the trip record, because POL-RD-01 says the trace figure governs where the two disagree and the rounded copy may not be cited for the threshold test. The booked optimal route is 3.20 km (EV-TRIP-02819, optimal_distance_km). Excess = 3.96 − 3.20 = 0.76 km, which is 23.75% of optimal. THE GATE. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km absolute. The percentage limb passes (23.75%). The absolute limb fails: 0.76 km is not greater than 0.80 km. Because both limbs must pass, no deviation exists on this trip and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the trip is characterised. The rider advocate's concession to precisely this effect is accepted, and the rider is right that the two distance fields straddle the threshold — the policy resolves that straddle against the rule the rider seeks. The driver advocate's threshold claims are accepted for the same reason: even on the rounded 4.00 km copy the excess is exactly 0.80 km, which still does not exceed 0.80 km, so the result is identical whichever field is read. CONSEQUENCES OF NO DEVIATION. POL-RD-02 does not run: there is no established deviation against which to recompute the fare, so the recomputed figure of 8.68 and the 0.96 difference against the charged total of 9.64 are not reached and are not paid. The contest is therefore not the rider's SGD 1.50 in the sense claimed. No exculpatory adjustment is needed on either side: POL-RD-04 supplies nothing because EV-CHAT-02819 carries zero messages and its 200 m corroboration test cannot be run; POL-RD-05 supplies nothing because pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null and no substitute re-quote may be invented; POL-RD-12 does not apply because the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. POL-RD-11 likewise does not apply: fare_model is METERED and no quoted_fare_sgd exists, so the upfront-pricing bar is irrelevant here. The 3.20 km comparator stands untouched. TRACE INTEGRITY. EV-GPS-02819 is not impaired for policy purposes: 100.0% coverage, 45 fixes at a 10-second interval against a 10-second expected interval, zero gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0 — none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met.
